task: Make every story-scoped mutating command always show a status ledger and surface render failures visibly, even when no milestone ledger exists.
outcome: A no-ledger story running a mutating command prints a Checklist-derived ledger block on stdout (never the Milestone Status header); a render failure prints a visible warning while the exit code stays 0.
facts: appendMilestoneStatusAfterMutation in packages/main/src/cli-engine.ts returns bare output when no milestone ledger exists and swallows render failures to stderr.
milestone_status can render a missing-ledger table but shows no per-item checklist progress.
An existing test deliberately forbids fabricating a Milestone Status table on no-ledger mutations.
constraints: The CLI cannot observe whether the agent forwarded stdout to the user.
The append runs after the mutation commits, so a display failure must not fail the command.
--json output must stay pure; the real-ledger and DONE worktree-cleanup fallbacks must be preserved.
unknowns: None material: the renderer shape and the append control-flow refactor are both determined by the decision record.
